overview_description.description: iMile is a logistics and courier services provider across the Middle East. It is the first courier company providing smart logistics and courier services to the e-Commerce business and brings the unique value of solving Cash On Delivery (COD). iMile offers a wide range of services like Cash on Delivery with tracking, Real-Time online tracking, 24 hours Customer support through Email, Chat, Social Media, SMS, International Transport, Overseas warehouses, and last-mile delivery.

about_short_description.short_description: iMile is a logistics and delivery services provider across the Middle East.

product.name: Domestic Delivery Service
product.description: Provides package pickup, sorting, transport, and last-mile delivery across multiple countries with real-time tracking and stable transit times.

product.name: International Delivery Service
product.description: Offers warehouse-to-door international shipping including packing, customs clearance, transport, and last-mile delivery across key global markets.

product.name: Return Service
product.description: Manages reverse logistics including pickup, transport, return center operations, and returning items to sellers with customized solutions.

product.name: Fulfillment Service
product.description: Provides secure storage, inventory management, order sorting, packing, and last-mile delivery to support e-commerce and B2B operations.

product.name: Cool Box Service
product.description: Offers temperature-controlled pickup, sorting, and last-mile delivery for sensitive goods with full tracking and customized services.

product.name: Mweb Platform
product.description: A technology platform offering dynamic tracking, appointment scheduling, and operational efficiency for customers.
